stemMd: If $g(x)=2(x+3)^2-8$, what is the smaller zero of $g$?
explanationMd: Set 2(x+3)²−8=0, giving (x+3)²=4. Thus x+3=±2, so x=−1 or −5. The smaller zero is −5.

distractorRationale.d: This reverses the sign of the smaller root.
